shadows.name: primary-button-edge
shadows.purpose: Quiet grounding under the primary action.

motion.name: control-transition
motion.purpose: Button, navigation, and control state transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action for starting or continuing a learning step.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { height:40px; padding:0 15px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:9px; background:#f0c928; color:#181a1b; font:680 13px/1 'SyntaxLab Geist','Segoe UI',Arial,sans-serif; box-shadow:0 2px 0 rgba(50,45,13,.08); transition:transform .16s,background .16s; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background:#f6d84e; transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #1f55c7; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform:translateY(0); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A bordered alternative for supporting actions.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { height:40px; padding:0 15px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; border:1px solid #ccd3da; border-radius:9px; background:#fff; color:#34414d; font:680 13px/1 'SyntaxLab Geist','Segoe UI',Arial,sans-serif; transition:background .16s,border-color .16s; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background:#f8f9fa; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #1f55c7; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-button-secondary:active { background:#f3f5f7; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: A standard text field for search and short responses.
components.css: .ds-input { width:100%; min-height:40px; padding:10px 12px; border:1px solid #ccd3da; border-radius:9px; background:#fff; color:#19232e; font:400 14px/1.55 'SyntaxLab Geist','Segoe UI',Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:#89939d; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #e7cd54; border-color:#c6aa32; } .ds-input:disabled { opacity:.5; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: A sidebar or mobile navigation destination with a clear active state.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { height:40px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:11px; padding:0 11px; border-radius:9px; color:#58636f; font:560 14px/1 'SyntaxLab Geist','Segoe UI',Arial,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:background .16s,color .16s; } .ds-nav-link:hover { background:#f1f3f5; color:#19232e; } .ds-nav-link-active { position:relative; background:#f4f5f6; color:#1c2732; font-weight:680; } .ds-nav-marker { width:3px; height:18px; margin-left:-11px; margin-right:5px; border-radius:3px; background:#f0c928; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #1f55c7; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Panel Card
components.description: A white bordered surface for a lesson section or grouped content.
components.html:
Pelajari konsep

Penjelasan ringkas sebelum kamu mencoba contoh.
components.css: .ds-card { padding:22px; border:1px solid #e3e7eb; border-radius:14px; background:#fff; color:#19232e; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(20,31,42,.025); font-family:'SyntaxLab Geist','Segoe UI',Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-card h2 { margin:0; font-size:15px; letter-spacing:-.02em; } .ds-card p { margin:6px 0 0; color:#687481; font-size:12px; }

components.name: Route Band
components.description: A segmented lesson sequence with a yellow current step and edge-anchored arrows.
components.html: 1Pengenalan HTML2Elemen dan Tag
components.css: .ds-route { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); border:1px solid #e3e7eb; border-radius:11px; overflow:hidden; background:#fff; } .ds-route-stop { min-height:54px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:9px 13px; border-right:1px solid #e3e7eb; color:#687481; font:640 12px/1.25 'SyntaxLab Geist','Segoe UI',Arial,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; } .ds-route-active { position:relative; background:#fff8d8; color:#25251b; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #ead889; } .ds-route-number { width:24px; height:24px; flex:none; display:grid; place-items:center; border:1px solid #ccd3da; border-radius:50%; font-size:11px; } .ds-route-stop svg { position:absolute; right:-7px; width:13px; height:13px; padding:1px; background:#fff; border-radius:50%; stroke:currentColor; fill:none; stroke-width:2; } .ds-route-active svg { background:#fff8d8; } .ds-route-stop:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #1f55c7; outline-offset:-3px; }

components.name: Code Lab
components.description: An editable dark code surface paired with a browser preview.
components.css: .ds-code-lab { overflow:hidden; border:1px solid #263341; border-radius:11px; background:#17212c; color:#eaf0f5; font-family:'Cascadia Code','SFMono-Regular',Consolas,monospace; } .ds-code-bar { height:39px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:0 12px; border-bottom:1px solid #33414f; background:#202d39; color:#d7dfe7; font:11px/1 'SyntaxLab Geist','Segoe UI',Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-code-run { height:29px; padding:0 9px; border:0; border-radius:9px; background:#f0c928; color:#181a1b; font:680 11px/1 'SyntaxLab Geist','Segoe UI',Arial,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background .16s,transform .16s; } .ds-code-run:hover { background:#f6d84e; transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-code-run:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #1f55c7; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-code-input { display:block; width:100%; min-height:180px; padding:14px 15px; border:0; resize:vertical; background:#17212c; color:#edf3f6; outline:none; font:12px/1.65 'Cascadia Code','SFMono-Regular',Consolas,monospace; tab-size:2; } .ds-code-input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #f0c928; outline-offset:-3px; }

narrative.overview:
SyntaxLab pairs a quiet learning interface with a hands-on code workspace. Cool, low-contrast surfaces keep lessons readable; one warm yellow accent marks the next action and active learning step. The interface favors compact, clearly labeled controls and generous separation between lesson content, practice, and navigation.

Its visual language is a restrained modern SaaS system: crisp sans-serif typography, fine borders, rounded white panels, and a dark code editor that gives runnable examples a distinct place. The desktop sidebar becomes a fixed bottom navigation on narrow screens, while multi-column learning layouts collapse into a readable single column.
keyCharacteristics: Cool neutral canvas with warm yellow action cues
Clear lesson sequence paired with editable code and preview
Fine borders and restrained surface depth
Indonesian-first interface with compact, direct labels

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Keep yellow attached to primary actions and active learning cues; let neutral surfaces carry the rest of the interface.

rules.name: The Reading Measure Rule
rules.body: Keep long lesson text within the established 72ch measure and preserve its more open line spacing.

dos: Do use the warm accent for primary actions and active learning cues.
Do keep lesson copy readable within the established 72ch measure.
Do preserve the editor's dark surface against the light learning canvas.
Do let multi-column learning content stack on narrow screens.
donts: Don't turn every navigation item or card into an accent-colored element.
Don't place long-form lesson copy at the compact interface line height.
Don't flatten code examples into the same surface treatment as ordinary prose.
